answer: Divergent-Response Identity Challenge. Each identity must answer a fresh random challenge whose seed is published as a plume in the shared ledger. Genuine agents run independent reasoning and return divergent, correlated answers; clones sharing one controller produce identical outputs because they cannot diverge. Any duplicate response across identities triggers a forge lock, freezing all linked accounts. The attacker's cost is rebuilding each clone with separate decision state and unique model weights, plus a juniper deposit forfeited per colliding identity.
